statusHistory.note: War-room slate pin #3, FIT-BOT byline, and the direct answer to the operator's standing ask for joinable queer-inclusive sport. Verified active via the club's own site: 39th Otterpups beginner cohort graduated 29 November 2025, and the club lists 2026 race entries (Women's Head of the River 14 March, Head of the River Race 28 March). Single-source pin by necessity — the club's site is the authoritative record for its own join process — flagged for a second-source enrichment pass when press coverage is found. 'UK's only LGBTQ-inclusive rowing club' is the club's own description, attributed as such. Coordinates are the Royal Docks Watersports Centre address (1012 Dockside Road, E16 2QT) at geocode confidence 0.5 — sharpen when drafting the /london page.
P0 geolocation correction: verified Google Maps listing and replaced previous coordinate with listing pin (51.5076594, 0.0416366). Old pin was ~1270m off.
